title: Inception
overview: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

title: Interstellar
overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

title: The Matrix
overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the 3D world machines.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a daring gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in a wild series of stories.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: Framed in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison.

title: The Godfather
overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family.

title: Forrest Gump
overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events.

title: Gladiator
overview: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.
